alias_note: Both aliases currently resolve to jev-1.13.0 and move on release; the pinned versioned id is used and a response whose `model` differs is rejected.
price_note: $0.042 per million input tokens (documented as $42 per billion); output tokens free; unchanged since the 2026-09-27 pin.

limits.rate: 100K tokens/s and 80 requests/s, 429 on excess, limits adjust dynamically

modalities: text only; English best, other languages not equally well
request_schema: questions is an OBJECT keyed by question id; choice: {type:'choice', instructions, criteria:{option: description|null}}; noul: {type:'noul', instructions, criteria?}; score: {type:'score', instructions, criteria}
response_schema: answers keyed by the same ids; choice: {type,choice,confidence,probabilities}; noul: {type,noul} with NO confidence; usage:{input_tokens,output_tokens}; top-level `model` reports the versioned id
defect_corrected: The Phase 9 browser adapter sent questions as an array with `options`/`id` fields and parsed a `value`/`sufficient` answer; neither matches the documented schema. Corrected 2026-10-09 (browser-opt/jev_adapter.py).
privacy: Documented: not trained on customer requests or responses. DPA, privacy policy and zero data retention (enterprise only) are on the Legal page and were NOT reviewed here; a recorded data-handling approval is required before any live use.
cap_note: Anthropic and ChatGPT caps and the LiteLLM proxy do not cover TypeSafe unless a pass-through is verified; the product gate reserves each call against the Phase 5 task allocation.
unconfirmed: retention terms for the account tier in use
